title: Existence and uniqueness of the nonflat relative norm
as_he_states: Define a quadraticA-valued norm onA1⊗A2 with pure-tensor valuesN1N2 and polarization given by the relative trace.
plausible_today: For genuine quadratic inputs the explicit integral polynomial gives a unique multiplicativeA-quadratic law, natural by its characterization. It need not arise from a determinant of a locally freeA-module.
state_of_art: CL-SA02-008–010 prove the coefficient formula and tower laws. Loos/Voight construct the contracted quadratic algebra. EGAII §6.5 gives norms for finite locally free algebras, plus a reduced generically free case with extra base-change restrictions. Ferrand1998 and Biesel2024 retain finite locally free base hypotheses.
why_open: 103 is tentative,105–106 states the characterization,107 closes the total-norm calculation. The author later isolates the nonflat obstacle for a more general triple construction; no stated reason for abandoning that broader programme is supplied.
worth: A focused run could give a clean basis-free theorem for this verified special norm and compare it precisely with universal polynomial-law norms.

title: When does the abstract product equal tensor invariants?
as_he_states: The canonical product map tends to be universally injective, but general injectivity and surjectivity are not known on104; the NB on102 gives a characteristic2/étale sufficient condition.
plausible_today: For two inputs, (2,b1,b2)=R suffices for universal injectivity and equality with diagonal invariants. For three, outside characteristic2 points with at least two nonétale inputs the triple invariant map is an isomorphism. These are sufficient conditions, not claimed necessary.
state_of_art: CL-SA02-006 proves the binary cover criterion directly. CL-SA02-024 proves the triple statement by eigenbasis when2 is a unit and by étale splitting otherwise. Loos1997 §2.8 warns that invariant modules can be too large and Prop2.9 gives the map.
why_open: The source explicitly distinguishes its conditional result from the general uncertainty; the characteristic2 degenerations explain the warning.
worth: Worth a finite local classification of kernels and excess invariants, provided it is separated from the already settled sufficient criteria.

title: Trace and norm transitivity through the contracted product
as_he_states: Check that the composed norm equals the ordinary norm of the rank-four tensor algebra; a tentative four-factor product is followed by anOK.
plausible_today: For genuine quadratic inputs, the explicit relative norm and trace satisfy both transitivity identities over every base.
state_of_art: CL-SA02-010 compares against the regular multiplication matrix exactly. Biesel Lemma2.6 proves the usual finite locally free tower theorem, which alone is insufficient here if the middle extension is nonflat.
why_open: The local proof closes on107. The image map is suppressed in one line but the scalar map into the tensor algebra is faithful in this setting.
worth: No new theorem search is needed beyond a concise proof note and explicit handling of the suppressed map.

title: Which quasi-quadratic axioms survive nonfaithful scalars?
as_he_states: Allow nonflatA/k and noninjectivek→A; impose the scalar polarization identity directly and list an optional tower law. The five numbered recap omits the earlier multiplicativity clause.
plausible_today: Keep a strong definition with universally multiplicative quadratic norm separate from the weaker five-axiom definition. Faithful scalars recover multiplicativity from the other identities; nonfaithful scalars require additional hypotheses.
state_of_art: TheZ/4 counterexample in CL-SA02-016 satisfies all five recap axioms as polynomial laws but fails multiplicativity. Roby1963 supplies quadratic-law extension; Chenevier2014 §1.19 gives the strong degree-two Cayley–Hamilton comparison. No exact later use of the manuscript term was found.
why_open: The text deliberately permits noninjectivity but gives no explanation for the missing clause. It is not legitimate to decide from the algebra whether this is an intentional weakening or an abbreviated recap.
worth: High value for a short run: state the two categories precisely and determine which later constructions require the stronger one.

title: Nonétale inverse images of a section
as_he_states: Generalize the canonical biquadratic structure to the inverse image of a section of a triple contracted product, without any étaleness assumption; construct relative traces and norms in the universal diagram.
plausible_today: The fibre need not be finite locally free or flat; a viable statement must specify quasi-quadratic polynomial laws and their exact base module and scalar-compatibility requirements, without assigning ranks4 and2 automatically.
state_of_art: CL-SA02-029 and051 separate finite/surjective from flat. The triple-dual-number example has an8-dimensional fibre and proves nonflatness. EGAII caseII covers reduced generically free situations under extra restrictions; Ferrand/Biesel do not cover this arbitrary nilpotent base. The exact universal construction remains unmatched in opened literature.
why_open: 122 explicitly names nonflatness as a difficulty, marks the proposed ranks and norm with question/exclamation marks, and ends with unfinished linearity/quadraticity conditions.
worth: The most promising substantial local research task, after the weak/strong axiom distinction is settled.

title: The standard conjectures recalled on the reused prose
as_he_states: The author questions the validity of the standard conjectures on cycles while treating the question as fundamental, and recalls pairing it with resolution atBombay1968.
plausible_today: Separate algebraicity of Lefschetz operators, Künneth projectors and Hodge-type positivity for smooth projective varieties and a Weil cohomology; this leaf does not choose a narrower version.
state_of_art: Grothendieck1969 pp195–198 gives exact formulations and implications. Deligne1974 proves the Weil estimate without settling the whole package. Agugliaro2025 Cor1.3 establishes Hodge-type positivity for powers of abelian threefolds over any field; the full programme remains open.
why_open: The prose records a change of confidence and an assessment of importance, not a failed proof or a reason a specific attempted argument was abandoned.
worth: Historically central but too broad for a few-hour research task; a precise bibliographic companion is the realistic next step.

title: Resolution of singularities recalled with the standard conjectures
as_he_states: Resolution is named as one of two fundamental questions, with no choice of characteristic, base class or embedded/functorial formulation.
plausible_today: Specify a birational regular-model problem before comparing results; alterations that enlarge the function field are a different assertion.
state_of_art: Cossart–Piltant2019 Th1.1 gives proper birational regular models for reduced separated Noetherian quasi-excellent schemes of dimension≤3, preserving the regular locus. deJong1996 Th4.1 gives arbitrary-dimensional alterations of varieties. General positive-characteristic resolution remains open in the primary2026 status source.
why_open: No proof attempt occurs here and no personal account explains why the general problem remained open; the leaf is a retrospective statement of priority.
worth: A new mathematical attack is not a bounded follow-up to these pages; the useful task is an exact historical and hypothesis concordance.
